name: Decision Board
description: A starter for turning scattered notes, links, and criteria into a living comparison board with tradeoffs and next questions.
permission_rationale: The app stores only its own decision notes and can open Live App Studio when the user chooses to make a personalized copy.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Starter App demonstrating how scattered information becomes a decision surface with criteria, tradeoffs, and next questions.
